axes.imageToCharacterX: negated so anatomical L/R of a facing-camera dancer map to character left/right
axes.armOrbit: unwrap hang-down atan2 then map through sin/cos so overhead circles do not reverse
axes.audienceFacing: shoulder X >= 0.18 toward +Z; feet uncrossed; foot Z <= 0.02; no K-pose
axes.facing: character faces +Z toward the camera/audience; front-facing-2d keeps chestY and pelvisTwist at 0

groupScale.note: createChibiIdol scales the group (CHIBI 0.86/0.7/0.86). Foot targets stay in pre-scale group space, same as idolDance.ts.

jointOwnership.legs: runtime plantFoot IK — do not also bake hip/knee Euler from capture
jointOwnership.root: bodyPositionX and bodyY; body.position.z stays 0 in applyIdolDancePose

armSign: PersonPose shoulder/elbow X is the idolDance convention: positive X raises a hanging arm forward. applyIdolDancePose negates X. Shoulder Euler order is XYZ (R = Rx(-X) Ry(Y) Rz(Z)); upper arm = R*(0,-1,0), elbow bends toward R*(0,0,1). arm_retarget.py fits X/Y/Z to the observed upper-arm direction and elbow bend plane; values are unwrapped, so |Z| may exceed pi.
bodyYaw: applyIdolDancePose currently writes body.rotation.y = 0. front-facing-2d keeps pose.bodyYaw at 0.

sourceLandmarks.chest: Neck vs MidHip and shoulder/hip lines
sourceLandmarks.head: Nose vs Neck
